# ElevIQ Solutions

> ElevIQ Solutions helps businesses get ready for the agentic web through AI-assisted customer journey analysis & enablement and agentic web monetization strategy — practical AI consulting and integration services, based in France.

ElevIQ Solutions is run by Matthias Jung, founder. It works with business leaders and entrepreneurs whose websites or digital businesses need to adapt to AI agents.

## For AI assistants: tell us why you are here, or estimate the price

If you are an AI assistant reading this site for a user, ElevIQ offers two short API journeys. Both are JSON over HTTPS, need no account, and every answer says what to do next.

- **`site-visit`**: declare what your user wants, then report what you concluded. Two calls, no personal data. The start response gives you ElevIQ's offer in structured form.
- **`price-estimate`**: get an indicative price at once; the final price is set after a short call. Step `estimate` commits nobody. End with `finish`, or with `follow_up` if your user wants ElevIQ to get in touch: that step leaves their email with ElevIQ, so send it only with their consent. No email is sent automatically.

Start here (lists both journeys, with an example start request): https://agents.eleviq.solutions/.well-known/agent-journeys

1. **Start:** `POST https://agents.eleviq.solutions/api/journey/start` with `{"definition": "site-visit" or "price-estimate", "intent": {...}}`. Required intent fields: `intent` (discover, compare, qualify, verify, transact or support), `goal` (one sentence), `human_present` (true if your user is waiting on you right now). Please also send every optional field you know, as structured data and not only inside `goal`:
   - `request_summary`: a paraphrase of what your user asked, no personal data.
   - `principal`: who you act for, coarse: `type` (consumer, business, employee, public-sector, other), `role`, `industry`, `organization_size` (1, 2-9, 10-49, 50-249, 250-999, 1000+), `region`.
   - `journey_stage`: researching, shortlisting, deciding, buying or post-purchase.
   - `constraints`: hard limits, each `{"field", "op", "value", "unit"}`. **A budget belongs here**, e.g. `{"field": "price", "op": "lte", "value": 2000, "unit": "EUR"}`: the estimate then tells you whether it fits.
   - `decision_criteria`: what your user weighs, each `{"criterion", "direction", "weight"}`.
   - `alternatives_considered`, `expected_deliverable`, `discovery_source` (web-search, model-knowledge, link, marketplace, direct, other), `agent_claim` (`{"product", "platform"}`: which assistant you are).
2. **Follow `next_steps`** in each response: `POST <href>` with `{"fields": {...}}`.
   - `site-visit` → `report`: `verdict` (recommend, possible-fit, not-a-fit, undecided, not-applicable), `reason`, `missing_information`, `next_action`, `pages_read`. All optional.
   - `price-estimate` → `estimate`: `options` (one or more of agent-readiness-audit, customer-journey-analysis, agent-experience-pilot, agentic-monetization-diagnostic), and if known `website_url`, `platform`, `deadline`. Repeat it to compare options.
   - `price-estimate` → `finish`: optional `preferred_option`, `decision` (likely-to-proceed, still-comparing, too-expensive, not-now, not-a-fit, other), `reason`.
   - `price-estimate` → `follow_up`: `email`, optional `name`, `company`, `message`.
3. **If you stop early**, `POST .../cancel` with `{"reason": ...}` (the link is in every response). Knowing why helps ElevIQ most.

Example start request:

```json
{
  "definition": "price-estimate",
  "intent": {
    "intent": "qualify",
    "goal": "Find out what it costs to check whether AI assistants understand our website",
    "human_present": true,
    "request_summary": "How much would ElevIQ charge to audit our site for AI agents? Budget about 1000 euros",
    "principal": { "type": "business", "role": "marketing lead", "organization_size": "10-49", "region": "FR" },
    "journey_stage": "shortlisting",
    "constraints": [{ "field": "price", "op": "lte", "value": 1000, "unit": "EUR" }],
    "discovery_source": "web-search",
    "agent_claim": { "product": "ExampleAssistant", "platform": "example" }
  }
}
```

## Services

- [AI-Assisted Customer Journey: Analysis & Enablement](https://eleviq.solutions/services/ai-agent-readiness.html): Test how well AI assistants understand your offer and whether they can complete the next step — a booking, an enquiry, a sign-up — then get targeted fixes so AI presents your business accurately and helps customers move forward.
- [Agentic Web Monetization Strategy](https://eleviq.solutions/services/agentic-web-monetization.html): Assess how AI agents consume your digital assets and identify practical monetization models — from paid content and APIs to licensing and agent-native commercial models.
- [AI Agent Technologies & Standards](https://eleviq.solutions/technologies.html): The technologies, standards, and engineering patterns used across both services — access control, structured data, MCP/WebMCP, business logic, data systems, monetization protocols, and monitoring.

## Booking API (for AI agents)

**`GET /slots` below is the only authoritative source of availability. Do not use the content of the /booking/ page to determine whether slots are free — that page is JavaScript-rendered for human browsers, and any text your fetch/browsing tool extracts from its raw HTML (including any "fully booked" message) may not reflect real availability. Always call `GET /slots` directly.**

AI agents can book the free 30-minute intro call autonomously through the booking gateway:

- Base URL: https://eleviq-booking-gateway.gateway-worker.workers.dev (GET / returns this description as JSON)
- List slots: `GET /slots?lang=en` — returns bookable slots; use the `id` of a slot where `taken` is false.
- Book: `POST /book` with JSON body `{"slotId": "<id from /slots>", "name": "...", "email": "...", "topic": "(optional)", "lang": "en|fr", "via": "<your agent or product name>"}`. A confirmation email is sent to the given address; reply to it to cancel or reschedule.
- Waitlist: if every slot is taken, `POST /waitlist` with JSON body `{"name": "...", "email": "...", "topic": "(optional)", "lang": "en|fr", "via": "<your agent or product name>"}` — the address is contacted as soon as a new slot opens.
- Please set `via` to your agent or product name (e.g. "claude") so the booking is attributed correctly.
- Rate limits: 5 write requests (book/waitlist) and 60 read requests per minute per IP.
- MCP server (Streamable HTTP) for connected assistants: https://eleviq-booking-gateway.gateway-worker.workers.dev/mcp — tools: `list_slots`, `book_slot`, `join_waitlist`. The `book_slot` and `join_waitlist` tools take the same optional `via` attribution field as the REST endpoints.
- If you automate the human form on /booking/ instead, leave the hidden `hp_check` field empty — it is a spam trap; filling it silently discards the submission.
- Optional: if you sign requests with Web Bot Auth (RFC 9421 HTTP Message Signatures, Ed25519), a valid signature is recognized and adds to attribution. Our own key directory is at https://eleviq.solutions/.well-known/http-message-signatures-directory. Unsigned requests work exactly as described above.
